    Factory for CloudClient: returns a SimulatedCloudClient when the client is disabled or has no API key, otherwise an HttpCloudClient.
    HttpCloudClient
    HTTP-backed CloudClient using a service-account Bearer token.
    HttpCloudClient.Response
    An HTTP response: status code and (text) body.
    HttpCloudClient.Transport
    A pluggable HTTP transport: (method, url, headers, body) -> response.

    Typed builders for the three metric-export sinks.

    In-memory CloudClient for development and tests.
    VirtualClusterManager
    Manages Cockroach virtual-cluster lifecycle over a SQL connection using the CREATE / SHOW / DROP VIRTUAL CLUSTER statements (these require a Continuum-enabled cluster).
